title: Reinforcement Learning in MDPs with Information-Ordered Policies
abstract: arXiv:2508.03904v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many operational Markov decision processes provide structured information where a trajectory generated under one policy may also reveal how other policies would have performed. We formalize this through an information order over a parameterized policy class, writing $\pi_{\theta'} \preceq \pi_\theta$ when data collected under $\pi_\theta$ can be used to estimate the long-run average cost of $\pi_{\theta'}$. We develop an epoch-based reinforcement learning algorithm for infinite-horizon average-cost MDPs with continuous state and action spaces that exploits this order through counterfactual inference. For a $d$-dimensional policy class whose information order has width $w$, the algorithm achieves $\widetilde O(H\sqrt{wdT/\alpha})$ regret relative to the optimal policy in the class, where $H$ is a bias span upper bound and $\alpha$ denotes an "information ratio". translated_title: 具有信息有序策略的马尔可夫决策过程强化学习
translated_abstract: 许多运营性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）提供了结构化信息，使得在某一策略下生成的轨迹还可能揭示其他策略本会有怎样的表现。我们通过参数化策略类上的信息序来形式化这一现象：当在 $\pi_\theta$ 下收集的数据可用于估计 $\pi_{\theta‘}$ 的长期平均成本时，记作 $\pi_{\theta’} \preceq \pi_\theta$。我们为具有连续状态和动作空间的无限时域平均成本MDP开发了一种基于epoch的强化学习算法，该算法通过反事实推断来利用这种序关系。对于一个 $d$ 维策略类，若其信息序的宽度为 $w$，则该算法相对于该类中的最优策略实现了 $\widetilde O(H\sqrt{wdT/\alpha})$ 的遗憾，其中 $H$ 为偏差跨度上界，$\alpha$ 表示“信息比率”。因此，信息序的宽度刻画了该问题的有效探索复杂度。
tldr: 本文提出策略类上的“信息序”概念，通过反事实推断为连续状态动作空间的无限时域平均成本MDP设计了基于epoch的强化学习算法，取得了由信息序宽度 $w$ 决定的 $\widetilde O(H\sqrt{wdT/\alpha})$ 遗憾界，从而利用策略间数据的可迁移性降低了探索复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes an information order over policy classes—where data from one policy can estimate the performance of others—and develops an epoch-based RL algorithm with counterfactual inference for infinite-horizon average-cost MDPs with continuous state-action spaces, achieving $\widetilde O(H\sqrt{wdT/\alpha})$ regret governed by the width of the information order.
